figures.caption: FIG. 1. Schematic of the dynamics of six nodes, v1, . . . , v6, and two hyperedges, e1 and e2. The two hyperedges share one node, v3. Variable Xi(t) for i ∈ {1, . . . , 6} denotes the state of vi at time t, which is either h or ℓ. Variable λe,j(t) for j ∈ {1, 2} represents the event probability on the jth hyperedge at time t [Eqs. (1) and (2) for AND and LIN rules, respectively]. Note that 0 < λℓ ≤ λe,j ≤ λh. Variables e1(t), e2(t), and v3(t) represent the time series of events on two hyperedges and node v3; at any t, they are equal to 1 when there is an event and 0 when there is no event. Equation (21) determines v3(t) from e1(t) and e2(t).
TABLE I. Descriptive statistics of the six empirical temporal hypergraphs. We remind that N is the number of nodes, E is the number of hyperedges, and T is the number of time points.

FIG. 6. Results of empirical data analysis. We show the average event probability, Ωe, the CV of the IET distribution, and the ACF, Ae(td), in the left, center, and right panels, respectively, each for hyperedges. Each row of the figure corresponds to one empirical temporal hypergraph.
